fault_proof_legend.FP0: NOT_APPLICABLE_DETERMINISTIC_INPUT: malformed/mismatched deterministic input is itself the proof.
fault_proof_legend.FP1: REQUIRED_SIGNED_STATE: independent signed/anchored registry, attestation, certificate, revocation, time, or witness state.
fault_proof_legend.FP2: REQUIRED_CONCURRENCY_TRACE: independent trace of concurrent attempts plus commit outcomes.
fault_proof_legend.FP3: REQUIRED_STORAGE_FAULT: independently captured rollback/corruption/outage/store mutation evidence.
fault_proof_legend.FP4: REQUIRED_RUNTIME_ATTESTATION: workload/runtime/sandbox identity or violation evidence independent of target guard result.
fault_proof_legend.FP6: REQUIRED_EXTERNAL_EFFECT: provider attempt/receipt/observation/reconciliation evidence independent of effect success guard.
